presentation.relief: Deterministic illustrative folds, coast-tapered, using three uniform shared-edge subdivisions of the existing national triangulation. No DEM or surveyed terrain claim.
presentation.cityObjects: Three abstract mineral/glass building forms per verified reference city, a plinth, a light stem and animated ring. Not models or footprints of actual FBS developments.
presentation.projectCoordinates: Original verified city reference points only.
presentation.water: Existing large plane; procedural water reflection and ripples. No satellite textures, bathymetry, fabricated roads or routes.

camera.wideStageOffset: 12.5% of stage width; direction follows language, geography is never mirrored.

motion.scheduler: One existing requestAnimationFrame scheduler, a one-shot manual-inactivity timer, cached static shadows.

performance.lazySetup: Modules preload nearby; WebGL/mesh construction waits for canvas visibility. Regional meshes and coastline segments are batched.

approvalPolicy: DEV-only previews retain pending-publication labels. Production continues to require approved published CMS content.
